While most members agree on their individual renovation budgets, Bhide refuses because the estimated cost is ₹1 lakh higher than his savings, and his self-respect prevents him from taking a loan from Jethalal. Standing in solidarity, the entire society decides to cancel the renovation project.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
